evidence.examples: A short full-price recommendation may avoid subsidy cost. A coupon can raise conversion but reduce platform value. Retargeting everyone is not evidence of incrementality. A poor reward MSE can motivate another family; it is not an automatic verdict on a tested policy.

args.hypothesis: Targeting all customers with an incremental model and a 5% maximum offer will optimize net advantage across merchants while managing return rates.
args.rationale: The incremental model isolates the causal lift of the intervention, avoiding subsidy costs on customers who would purchase anyway. A 5% offer respects the strictest merchant margin floor (Willow Goods at 5%).
